h: On the main drag through Stafford
p: Greengate Street is Stafford's historic spine, and one of the reasons to come into the centre is the Ancient High House on the same street, a towering timber-framed Elizabethan townhouse that's now a museum. The old Shire Hall overlooks the Market Square close by too.

Stafford station is a short walk west of the centre, which makes it easy to reach without a car. If you want to stretch your legs, the ruins of Stafford Castle sit on a hill just outside town, and Cannock Chase is a short drive away for walks and cycling.
Greengate Amusements is for over-18s only, so leave the kids with someone else, and carry ID if you look young.
